title: Bayesian optimization on amortized search space
abstract: arXiv:2611.26459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In real-world black-box optimization problems, a mechanistic simulator is often available that approximately predicts the behavior of the system as a function of the parameters being optimized. Here, we show how an amortized inverse map of such a simulator can be used in Bayesian optimization to restrict the search space while using a Gaussian process kernel that is aware of the original problem geometry. This allows for efficiently leveraging the low intrinsic dimensionality of the optimization problem. We characterize its approximation bias and information gain, and derive an intrinsic-dimension-dependent regret rate under additional geometric and Gaussian Process assumptions. We illustrate the method with an application to drug dosing personalization in Parkinson's disease. translated_title: 摊销式搜索空间上的贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的黑盒优化问题中，通常存在一个机理模拟器，它能够以被优化参数的函数形式近似预测系统的行为。本文展示了如何利用此类模拟器的摊销式逆映射来限制贝叶斯优化的搜索空间，同时使用能够感知原始问题几何结构的高斯过程核。这使得我们能够高效地利用优化问题的低内在维度。我们刻画了该方法的近似偏差和信息增益，并在额外的几何与高斯过程假设下，推导出了依赖于内在维度的遗憾率。我们以帕金森病的药物剂量个性化作为应用实例来说明该方法。我们使用药物的药代动力学/药效动力学（PK/PD）模型作为模拟器，这是一个基于群体数据校准并量化了参数不确定性的机理模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用机理模拟器的摊销式逆映射来约束搜索空间的贝叶斯优化方法，通过感知问题几何的高斯过程核高效利用问题的低内在维度，并给出了依赖内在维度的遗憾率理论保证，成功应用于帕金森病的药物剂量个性化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian optimization method that leverages an amortized inverse map of a mechanistic simulator to restrict the search space, efficiently exploiting the low intrinsic dimensionality of the problem with a geometry-aware Gaussian process kernel, providing intrinsic-dimension-dependent regret guarantees, and demonstrating its application to drug dosing personalization in Parkinson's disease.
